goal: Verify that the candidate keeps inherited body, wing and tail data while changing only local jaw skinning
steps: Fingerprint geometry, UV, weights, actions and packed images in the inherited baseline
Fingerprint the candidate with the same script
Compare signatures and list skin-weight vertex differences
observations: LOD0/1/2 geometry and UVs match the inherited baseline exactly.
All seven action keyframe signatures and all packed image signatures match.
LOD1/2 weights match exactly; LOD0 changes weights on 143 vertices around the mouth, including one vertex pruned from five to four influences.
Data preservation is not a visual deformation approval; the mouth still fails.
